Kit summary

Chaotic WaterballBasic
Deals 260% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 40% chance to inflict [Wet II] for 2 turns and a 20% chance to inflict [SPD Down I] for 2 turns.
Waterdrop MazeActiveExclusive Lv.1
Cleanses 3 layers of non-control debuffs from all allies and restores all allies' HP by 12% of Villette's Max HP. Afterward, attacks all enemies, removing 1 layer of a buff from each enemy first and then dealing 100% ATK DMG to them.
Spiral Staff Lv.1Waterdrop Maze: Also grants all allies [Block Debuff] for 1 turn.
Sound of SpiralsPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Villette gains 1 layer of [Afflatus] at the beginning of her turns or upon any target's death, up to 8 layers and will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition. After Villette gains [Afflatus] at the beginning of her turns, triggers extra effects based on the number of layers of [Afflatus] owned: 1 layer: Restores all allies HP by 5.2% of Villette's Max HP. 4 layers: Also grants all allies [Ripple I] for 2 turns. 8 layers: Also grants all allies [Ripple II] for 2 turns.
Spiral Staff Lv.2When an ally's HP is lower than 30%, Villette cleanses all debuffs from them immediately and restores their HP by 12% of Max HP. For every 1 layer of [Afflatus] owned by Villette, additionally restores their HP by 1.5% of Max HP. Skill CD: 3 turns.
Ocean WavesActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 180% ATK DMG to all enemies and triggers extra effects based on the number of layers of [Afflatus] owned: 1 layer: There is a 40% chance to inflict [Wet II] for 2 turns. 4 layers: Makes all enemies lose 18% of Max HP (caps at 54% of Villette's Max HP). 8 layers: There is also a 40% chance to inflict [Feebleness II] for 2 turns.
Spiral Staff Lv.3Ocean Waves: Inflicts 3 layers of [Raging Waves] for 2 turns (up to 3 layers) on enemies before dealing DMG. Each time the target with [Raging Waves] takes DMG from active skills, loses 8% of Max HP (caps at 24% of Villette's Max HP) and 1 layer of [Raging Waves] will be removed.
